headline: Does Softer Candy Demand Shift Hershey’s (HSY) Pricing Power Or Just Investor Expectations?
summary: In late July 2026, Hershey signaled that its upcoming second-quarter results would likely show revenue coming in below earlier expectations, reflecting softer confectionery consumption in its core North American market. At the same time, analysts trimmed their earnings forecasts and now expect only modest revenue growth, underscoring how shifts in consumer demand are shaping sentiment around Hershey’s near-term performance.
